references.text: The priest shall examine and declare the person clean or unclean based on the symptoms, following the same principle as in verse 37
The priest declares the person clean when signs of healing are visible, parallel to the declaration of cleanness in verse 37
Earlier verses concerning the examination of netek (scall) on the seventh day, direct context for verse 37
Describes the priest's role in declaring a leprous person clean after healing, the same official function as in verse 37
Reminder to follow the priests' instructions regarding leprosy, confirming the priest's authority to declare cleanness
